title: Symplectic Tangent Map for Planetary Motions
finding: Established efficient first-order tangent maps for nearly Keplerian leapfrog maps.
scope_caveat: Does not establish the exact REBOUND WHCKL lazy-kernel/order-17 implementation.

title: WHFast: a fast and unbiased implementation of a symplectic Wisdom-Holman integrator
finding: Implements Jacobi/Kepler/interaction first variations and MEGNO/LCN for the standard WHFast kernel.
scope_caveat: The 2015 work predates the later high-order lazy kernel.

title: High-order symplectic integrators for planetary dynamics and their implementation in REBOUND
authors: Hanno Rein; Daniel Tamayo; Garett Brown
finding: Defines WHCKL lazy kernel and order-17 corrector; explicitly states the new kernels do not support variational equations or MEGNO.
scope_caveat: Absence in one implementation is not by itself a universal novelty proof.

title: The long-term stability of extrasolar system HD 37124
authors: Krzysztof Gozdziewski; Slawomir Breiter; Wojciech Borczyk
finding: Demonstrates symplectic tangent-map MEGNO in planetary dynamics.
scope_caveat: Different splitting, coordinates, and corrector/lazy-kernel structure.

title: The Reversibility Error Method
authors: Federico Panichi; Krzysztof Gozdziewski; Giorgio Turchetti
finding: Uses a fourth-order SABA tangent map and MEGNO over planetary systems.
scope_caveat: Not an exact WHCKL derivative or restart design.

title: Numerical integration of variational equations
finding: Provides the systematic derivative-of-composed-map framework and validates it for chaos indicators.
scope_caveat: General theory does not supply REBOUND-specific primitive ordering.

title: A differentiable N-body code for transit timing and dynamical modelling I
authors: Eric Agol; David Hernandez; Zachary Langford
finding: Propagates Jacobians through a symplectic N-body map and transit observers.
scope_caveat: Uses a different pairwise-Kepler architecture and Newtonian gradients.

title: Second-order variational equations for N-body simulations
finding: Documents REBOUND variation indexing and higher-order differential framework.
scope_caveat: Does not add high-order WH kernels.

title: REBOUND 4.6.0 source
finding: Native variations are rejected for nondefault kernels; lazy positions are shifted by h^2*A/12; corrector order 17 has 16 Z stages.
scope_caveat: Source fact is version-specific and not a universal novelty claim.

title: Current REBOUND repository issues and pull requests
source_symbol_or_section: Open issues and PR title/query review
finding: No public issue or PR matching WHCKL/lazy-kernel first variations or tangent-aware correctors was identified in the searched scope.
scope_caveat: Negative search is not proof of absence; private/unindexed work may exist.

title: REBOUNDx: a library for adding conservative and dissipative forces
authors: Daniel Tamayo; Hanno Rein; Peng Shi; David Hernandez
finding: Separates gr_potential, central-body velocity-dependent 1PN, and full 1PN models and warns about force splitting.
scope_caveat: Relativity architecture prior art, not WHCKL tangent implementation.

title: REBOUNDx 4.6.1 source
finding: Version-matched equations and model hierarchy used for the relativity audit.
scope_caveat: Installed version differs from current documentation 4.6.2 only in version identity reviewed here.

title: A study of symplectic integrators for planetary system problems
finding: Clarifies canonical variables, shadow Hamiltonians, and appropriate symplectic tests.
scope_caveat: Does not provide the requested WHCKL tangent implementation.

title: On the accuracy of symplectic integrators for secularly evolving planetary systems
authors: Hanno Rein; Garett Brown; Daniel Tamayo
finding: Shows why higher-order kernels can improve secular accuracy beyond energy-only comparisons.

title: Two fast integrators for the Galactic tide effects in the Oort Cloud
authors: Slawomir Breiter; Michel Fouchard; Radoslaw Ratajczak
finding: Discusses tangent maps with correctors and notes higher derivative complexity for its distinct corrector.
scope_caveat: Its corrector depends on a different potential structure; it does not imply a Hessian for REBOUND's first corrector sequence.

title: Step 3g0 novelty conclusion
finding: The exact combination of WHCKL lazy-kernel first variations, differentiated order-17 corrector, arbitrary position-force JVP, observer ownership, and exact restart is a novel combination or extension.
scope_caveat: Do not claim first-ever or universal absence without broader independent scholarly review.
